title: SleuthBench Template
description: Defines the structure of a SleuthBench question template, including parameterized slots, dataset requirements, and phenomenon injectors.

template_id.description: Unique identifier for this template, conventionally {category_prefix}_{name}_v{version} (e.g. dq_bad_row_indicator_v0).

description.description: Human-readable description of the injected phenomenon. Not read by template matching or injection, but it is part of the runner's generation fingerprint, so editing it invalidates Stage 1 reuse.

category.description: One of the two public benchmark categories: Data Quality (dq_ templates) and Feature Contribution (fc_ templates: feature-importance, shape-function and interaction questions).

answer_format.description: Expected format of the ground-truth answer. Stored in QA pairs and passed through to evaluation results.

business_question.description: Business-framed question text presented to the LLM. Use {SLOT_NAME} placeholders resolved from slot assignments; a placeholder matching an upper-cased scalar key of the injector's effects dict (e.g. {FEATURE}) is filled after injection.

ds_question.description: Data-science-framed question text presented to the LLM. Use {SLOT_NAME} placeholders resolved from slot assignments; a placeholder matching an upper-cased scalar key of the injector's effects dict (e.g. {FEATURE}) is filled after injection.

slots.description: Named parameter slots. Keys are slot names referenced in the question via {SLOT_NAME} syntax and in phenomena via param_mapping.

feature_pool.description: Column exclusion rules used only to count features for the min_feature_count requirement. They do not restrict which columns an injector may select or modify.

phenomena.description: Phenomena to inject. Each entry names an injector and maps its parameters to slot values. Same injector + same resolved params = single instance even if multiple templates reference it.

requirements.description: Dataset compatibility requirements. A template is skipped for datasets that don't meet all requirements.

kind_enum.description: Column kind as classified in dataset summaries.

dtype_enum.description: Column data type as classified in dataset summaries.

slot_column.description: A slot that resolves to a dataset column name.

source.description: Where to source the column. 'dataset.target' binds to the dataset's target column.

kind_any_of.description: Column must have one of these kinds to match.

dtype_any_of.description: Column must have one of these dtypes to match.

unique_count_min.description: Minimum unique_count recorded in the dataset summary. The summary counts at most 100 sampled values, so thresholds above 100 never match.

unique_count_max.description: Maximum unique_count recorded in the dataset summary (sampled, capped at 100).

slot_string.description: A slot that resolves to a string value, optionally sourced from a column's values.

source.description: Set to 'column_values' to pick a value from the column named by source_column.

source_column.description: Name of another slot (must be a column slot) whose column's values are sampled. Required when source is 'column_values'.

position.description: How to pick a value from the column: 'random' samples uniformly, 'middle' picks the median-positioned value.

default.description: Default value if no source is specified.

slot_int.description: A slot that resolves to an integer value.

default.description: Default value used when the slot is not explicitly assigned.

min.description: Fallback value used when no default is set. Not enforced as a bound.

max.description: Documented upper bound; not enforced by the pipeline.

slot_float.description: A slot that resolves to a floating-point value.

default.description: Default value used when the slot is not explicitly assigned.

min.description: Fallback value used when no default is set. Not enforced as a bound.

max.description: Documented upper bound; not enforced by the pipeline.

slot.description: A parameter slot, discriminated by the 'type' field.

feature_pool.description: Column exclusion rules used only to count features for the min_feature_count requirement; injectors do not receive them.

exclude_target.description: Whether to exclude the dataset's target column from the feature pool.

exclude_kinds.description: Column kinds to exclude from the feature pool.

exclude_dtypes.description: Column dtypes to exclude from the feature pool.

phenomenon.description: A phenomenon to inject into the dataset.

injector.description: Phenomenon name; it must be registered in src/phenomena/__init__.py PHENOMENA.

param_mapping.description: Maps injector parameter names to slot values. Use {SLOT_NAME} to reference a slot's resolved value, or a literal string.

requirement_min_feature_count.description: Requires at least N features (non-excluded columns) in the dataset.

requirement_min_count_by_kind.description: Requires at least N columns of a specific kind.

min.description: Minimum number of columns of this kind.

requirement_min_count_by_dtype.description: Requires at least N columns of a specific dtype.

min.description: Minimum number of columns of this dtype.

requirement_min_count_by_dtype_any_of.description: Requires at least N columns matching any of the listed dtypes.

min.description: Minimum number of columns matching any listed dtype.

requirement.description: A dataset compatibility requirement, discriminated by the 'type' field.
